name: smwsprites-cloud-ball
title: Cloud Ball
description:
This is a 16x16 horizontally moving sprite, which will try to follow Mario and periodically drop coins and play a sound effect. After dropping a configurable amount of coins, it will disappear in a puff of smoke.

If the extra bit is set, it will successively toss a list of sprites and then disappear. The sound effect for each sprite can be customized.

No GFX included, so you will have to draw them by yourself.

To be assembled with PIXI.
